extraction.Name: Andrew Russell
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Washabaugh County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: when he received the receipt for his patent in fee that he did not want it and that he wrote to the Superintendent saying that I did not want the patent for his land but the Superintendent wrote back saying it did not make any difference what I did ,the patent would be in his office and that I would have to pay taxes on the land, so I sent 10 cents to the Superintendent to send the patent to me and it was sent to me as a registered letter
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold one-half section to Raymond Cozad, of Martin, S.D. for $2800.00 and he was to pay the back taxes
extraction.Buyer: Raymond Cozad, of Martin, S.D. for $2800.00, with buyer to pay back taxes (amount unknown)
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he was unable to pay the taxes on the land and he sold one-half section
extraction.Occupation/Income: works around doing little work which makes it hard to support his family, on account of poor health
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in poor health, which makes it impossible to do much work; has a wife and three small children; has not received any help from the Government, State or County since he was granted a patent in fee; does not think he received a fair price for the land; patent date not remembered; document signed December 13, 1928
